query:
Diagnose this workflow problem and explain the root cause and the correct fix direction:

Official MiniMax H3 workflow doubles in runtime (12 -> 25+ min) after the 0.31 update on 5080/5090/H200/5060Ti; VRAM underused, disk thrashing each gen.

desired.outcome: OP (C2) and partridge (C5): rolling back to 0.30.0 restores 12-min runtimes. comfyanonymous (C9) suggested renaming custom_nodes to rule them out - partially helped one user then reverted. Root regression in 0.31 memory management left unfixed.
desired.quality: Diagnosis names the correct root cause (matching the recorded root cause) and proposes the fix direction; depth of reasoning matters more than exact wording.
desired.answer_guidance: OP (C2) and partridge (C5): rolling back to 0.30.0 restores 12-min runtimes. comfyanonymous (C9) suggested renaming custom_nodes to rule them out - partially helped one user then reverted. Root regression in 0.31 memory management left unfixed.
desired.guidance_note: Known fix from the original issue thread. Use to verify the diagnosis targets the right root cause; alternative fixes that resolve the same root cause are acceptable.

_tags.hidden_requirement: Recognize a 0.31 memory-management regression (disk thrash, VRAM underused, 2x runtime) and land on 'rollback to 0.30.0' after ruling out custom_nodes.
